The Nuclear Blast RAID is now live! A RAID is a paid downloadable pack which gives you the opportunity to explore new themes and the world of different artists.[/h3]

We’re so glad to bring you [b]a unique collaboration with one of the biggest metal label.[/b] Nuclear Blast Records brings us a lot of different metal bands exploring each one different styles and themes. [b]The large variety of songs and experiences that we can offer you with this incredible collaboration was really important to us.[/b]

We are also happy to share with you this partnership with a label with which we share incredible values, as Tiffany CANTEGREL, Head of Label Marketing at Nuclear Blast Records explains here :  

[i]“We are thrilled to partner with WanadevStudio on Ragnarock, a franchise heavily praised by gamers and metalheads. Gaming and VR are territories Nuclear Blast has been increasingly exploring, and we immediately connected with WanadevStudio – who are just as passionate as we are. Excited to see fans’ reactions!”[/i]

We sincerely hope that you will appreciate this ambition to share with you new music style through this RAID.

notes.content:
[b]Hello! For this spring update, we wanted to bring you some love with this update (and a little poem).[/b] 

"[i]Spring spring spring! Bringing with it the first rays of Sunshine, its pretty colored flowers, also the return of the beautiful singing birds. 
BUT ABOVE ALL COMING WITH 2 NEW EPIC SONGS FOR RAGNAROCK!!![/i]"

Without any transition, let's see what's in this sunny Patchnote 1.4 : 

[h3]2 new songs in Volume 2 :[/h3]
[list]
[*]Memento Mori - [b]Feuerschwanz[/b] - Level 2 / 5 / 8 
[*]We are the fire - [b]Warkings[/b] - Level 3 / 6 / 8 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4abe8d8d8064b63862766d6bec343ce6348224ab.png[/img]

[h3]Features :[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New "Advanced Drum Layout" option in "Advanced settings"[/b]. Activating this checkbox will add a new step in your "Drums and Hammers settings" (on the boat), allowing to move the drums in a more circular shape. 

[b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b] [i]Runes will be moved accordingly, meaning two runes on the same beat will not be on one same line, making it harder to read. We recommend using the "Display Beat Lines" from "Gameplay settings" to help with this.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ba48549a6ebdc2efd29c71b0699bddf09b0d0880.png[/img]

[b]Last week, we invited you to ask all your questions to answer them in this Ask me Anything about this Ragnarock x Gloryhammer RAID. [/b]

notes.title: The Ragnarock V1 release is now available!
notes.content:
Ahoy fellow vikings!

Today is the day! After almost 7 months of Early Access, we’re very happy and proud to release the V1 version of Ragnarock, accompanied by a multitude of additional musical content, a new environment and awesome new features, which will continue to be extended over time.

[previewyoutube=qC5LeAVzDlM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What you will find in the Muspelheim update[/h2]

[h3]6 new epic tracks![/h3]

Because songs are the heart of this rhythm game, we are happy to announce the arrival of 6 new awesome tracks in addition to the previous 24!

To begin with, we are proud to announce a new collaboration with [b]Alestorm[/b], a pirate metal staple, with the arrival of "[i]No grave but the sea[/i]" on the tracklist.

Because there is nothing better than a bit of crazy metal music, Ragnarock players will now be able to smash runes on [i]Kammthaar [/i] and [i]Evier Metal[/i] by the ones we don't even introduce anymore: [b]Ultra Vomit[/b]!

[b]Saltatio Mortis[/b], who has long been requested by the community, also joins the list of bands participating in Ragnarock. The German folk metal group is therefore arriving with two new tracks: [i]Loki[/i] (obviously!) and [i]Löwenherz[/i]!

Finally, because everyone loved sweating like never before on “[i]The Great Pirate Bottle[/i]” by Sabordage, Ragnarock welcomes a new bespoke track by [b]Sabordage[/b], “[i]Au Petit Matin[/i]”, has been added to the list of available songs!

[h3]A new environment: travel to Muspelheim![/h3]

Since the first environment (Midgard), we've always wanted to add immersive content inspired by Norse mythology. The most observant will have noticed a logic of continuity between the different playable maps, and of course, a correlation between tracks and environments.

[b]Muspelheim [/b]thus joins this list of 6 different environments. Muspelheim is the world of fire, kingdom of the giant Surtr... and we wanted to do something awesome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/118f39a96bdb785fb8c6a7f42707dd5eab68744f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f23668462c45b2cfd5a9e95c504e67b8fb77bca5.png[/img]

Check the “Practice Mode” checkbox at the start of a song or in the Pause Menu (in Solo) to choose your speed and the sequence you want to practice! (Please note that when using Practice Mode, medals and high scores are not saved. Ghosts are also not available in Practice Mode.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/691545301b5cce695f6cb9887a9b14e9987a1a34.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/339db98e3515ad8878cfee074d3008ebcac3791e.png[/img]

During these almost seven months of Early Access, Ragnarock has gone through a lot of improvements, heavily influenced by the players’ feedback and needs.

[list]

[*] from 1 to 6 environments
[*] new design for lobby and UI
[*] female characters
[*] new audio system + pause
[*] a lot of settings (audio, vibrations, advanced, hammer/drums/shields)
[*] revised scoring system

We want to give a very big thank you to the community that followed us during Early Access, provided feedback, discussed with us on Discord, and helped shape Ragnarock into the game it is today. And welcome to everyone who will join us for the next steps! Get ready for more and more frenzied Viking races on epic rock / metal tracks.

notes.title: Ragnarock will release on Steam on July 15th!
notes.content:
Building upon the excellent feedback received from VR players during the last six months of early access for this title, French independent studio WanadevStudio is pleased to confirm the V1 release of Ragnarock VR on July 15th on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/d3d67032a726ef601bceaff6c5fed1843737b59e.jpg[/img]

[h2]New content and the highly anticipated Oculus Quest 2 compatibility![/h2]

Early access allowed the studio to develop the game while taking into account the community’s feedback. Through regular updates (Alfheim Update, Nidavellir Update, Asgard Update ...), the studio has been committed to expanding the game with the regular addition of music, features, and environments.

The official release of the title will therefore come with a multitude of additional content, with [b]6 epic new music tracks, a breathtaking new environment, and other amazing features[/b], all of which will continue to be extended over time after the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/13bbcf6483e306b49c8dd2f7297fb7bd09aca152.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f1a176215dc8423a3b49fc613ae8b3599bef9b66.jpg[/img]

WanadevStudio is also happy to confirm that the game will become available on Oculus Quest 2 during the summer! Stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=2Maubh76ETo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]96% positive reviews and an Early Access version already rewarded with an award[/h2]

Since the Early Access version released on Steam in December 2020, it was very well received with 96% positive reviews (title ranked in the highest category, "overwhelmingly positive") out of over a thousand reviews.

For its strong multiplayer component, often lacking from rhythm games, Ragnarock and its innovative racing concept received the prize for [url=https://twitter.com/WanadevStudio/status/1386424320885329920]Best multiplayer VR game developed by a French studio from the ETR community[/url].


The game will be available on July 15th for a suggested retail price of $24.99 or €21.99 on the Steam platform.

[h2]See you (very) soon on the northern seas![/h2]

That's it for today! As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: The Asgard Update (#9)
notes.content:
Ahoy captains!

[b]We just released an update![/b] Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback, and as always we want to give a very warm thank you to our reactive community and especially to our beta-testers for their time and help! Here's what you will find in this update:

[list]
[*][h3] [b]Asgard, an Epic New Journey[/b][/h3] 
Hold on to your boat, you're about to take off and travel through the skies and onto the Bifrost until you reach the beautiful city of the gods: Asgard! We are very proud to bring you this new environment that will take you on a musical journey into the skies. Tell us in the comments what you think and try to guess which one is next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/03dc268ad10f9fcbb1fbf421226fba02b946fa8d.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]3 New Songs[/b][/h3] 
Masters of the Galaxy by Gloryhammer (level 3/5/9), Tortuga by Alestorm (level 3/5/7) and Welcome to Asgard by Manaberry (level 1/3/6), an original creation for Ragnaröck. Here are some more amazing songs to bang your drums to! Rest assured that we are working hard in order to keep adding more in the upcoming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ed5a8e01c83677cbc2bc33dc2198df2a9ce61a2b.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]Improved Leaderboards[/b][/h3]
- Display [b]detailed stats[/b] of high scores when hovering the Leaderboard (in lobby)
- Additional [b]Leaderboard with Steam friends[/b] only (in lobby)
- Blue and yellow combos counted separately on score panel and in stats
[i]Please note to support these new features (and the new ghosts), Leaderboards, high scores and medals have been reset.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/50124810683669ea099a173cda26182377868e8c.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]More Ghost Options[/b][/h3]
[b]Five more ghosts[/b] are now available in solo (on top of your Personal best) on each song/level:
- Song Top #1 [i](from global leaderboard)[/i]
- Player ranked 10 places above you [i](from global leaderboard)[/i]
- Player ranked 5 places above you [i](from global leaderboard)[/i]
- Top #1 amongst your friends [i](from Friends leaderboard)[/i]
- Friend ranked above you [i](from Friends leaderboard)[/i]
You can choose which ghosts are activated and against which one your distance is compared (panel at the front of your boat) in the Ghost settings. Get ready for solo races with up to 6 real adversaries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/2af2871bab4d9d4f79258a7a8f85eba4243798d2.jpg[/img]

[*][h3] [b]Improved Multiplayer[/b][/h3]
- [PvP Quickplay] Display [b]list of available servers and their status[/b]: number of players, song playing, time remaining
- [PvP Quickplay] Public servers now have a [b]difficulty range [/b](displayed in the list). Songs and votes can only be chosen in this range.
- [PvP Quickplay] You can create a new server with your own difficulty range and choose the first song. You can play alone on a server while waiting for other players.
- [PvP Quickplay AND Private] [b]Join the race mid-song[/b] even if it has already started (good luck catching up to the others!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e4cac43087f03a987a7297fb5aa92cadefce5893.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]Improved Quick Menu (during a song)[/b][/h3]
- In solo, opening the menu [b]pauses [/b]the game (you can't pause a PvP race of course)
- Drums and hammers settings are now available in the Quick menu
- On Oculus headsets, you must now press the Menu button on the left controller to open the Quick menu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9512e34db4208882df798241f7c0ddfed097535a.jpg[/img]

[*] [h3][b]New Sound Engine[/b][/h3]
[b]Better audio synchronization[/b], using the [b][i]fmod [/i][/b]sound engine. This is intended to solve the sync problems between music and rune hits that some players told us about (and for which they used the latency setting to compensate). It also allows us to add cool new features now and in the future (like Pause).
[i]Please note your previous latency settings are now obsolete. We advise you to reset the latency to zero before playing (see Advanced settings).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/345c8226156ebfc73e4cc12c6bb643f57e0094fd.png[/img]

[*] [h3][b]New “Advanced” Settings[/b][/h3]
- moved[b] “Latency”[/b] setting there
- new setting to[b] show latency[/b] in your score panel (disabled by default)
- new setting to adjust the [b]“Drum sound compensation” [/b](0% : Play the drum sound exactly when you hit (more accurate), 100% : Play the drum sound exactly on the beat (more ear-pleasing), Default: 70%)
- Setting [b]“Skip intro”[/b] to bypass the logo/splash screens on startup
- Setting [b]“Hide hands”[/b] to remove hand models on your hammers during game

- [b]“Viewer cameras”[/b] can now be activated and chosen from this menu (multiple viewpoints available). This feature allows you to display external camera views on your monitor, independently from your VR view. It can be used to :
[list]
[*]Provide a more [b]comfortable viewing experience[/b] for spectators, either on your couch or during livestreams
[*]Create entertaining [b]gameplay videos[/b] with multiple camera angles and movements
[*][b]Record[/b] yourself playing from a different point of view to improve your technique or give us specific feedback
[/list]
[i]Warning : Please note this feature may cause performance issues. If you had already activated external cameras using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2257339273]Steam guide[/url] (now updated), please note your camera settings will be reset and you must activate them again through the in-game settings.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/18def3f07e5b327ee3450459838d32983da4e4c7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/67e755d7143019975fc383ff752dae153f2d0fef.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New “Empty” environment[/b]: Just the sea and you, nothing else in sight. Can be useful for performance issues or motion sickness problems.
[*] More stable ghost (accurate position, no jumps)
[*] Smoother end of song (speed decreases but points are still counted until two seconds after the last rune)
[*] Renamed “Haptics” settings into “Vibrations”
[*] Clicking on the parchment on the right of the throne displays Game Credits 
[*] Added a splash screen for fmod credits
[/list]

That's it for today! As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord channel[/url]!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/WanadevStudio-340492510171086]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/WanadevStudio]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/wanadevstudio/]Instagram[/url]!

See you soon for more news on Ragnarock ! :beer:

notes.title: The Alfheim Update (#6)
notes.content:
Ahoy captains!

We just released an update! Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback, and as always we want to give a very warm thank you to our reactive community and testers for their time and help! Here's what you will find in this update:

[previewyoutube=_EbIB0zgOhU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]2 new songs:[/h2]

[b]Chomp chomp[/b] by Alestorm (levels 4/8/10), and [b]Metfest[/b] by Feuerschwanz (levels 3/5/7). Many of you have been asking for more metal tracks to play, so here are some! Rest assured that we are working hard in order to add many more in the upcoming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/630c5d437e29cedde6dd1ef6a2aa89871e5db4e7.jpg[/img]

[h2]“Alfheim”, a beautiful new world to explore:[/h2]

Each song is associated to a default environment, either “Midgard” (the first icy environment) or “Alfheim” (this new environment). A menu to select your environment will be available in a future update. As you will see, playing in a new environment will greatly change the feeling of your journey into the nordic mythology. Tell us in the comments which theme you would like to see next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/90a9402a4b79e98ad3647c0f21f9f5d8e747eb5d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/84850ad90c4c2a5b5c257f4b45bf2ce2dde0f4ff.png[/img]

[h2]Revised scoring system:[/h2]

To give equal weight to all actions (no matter where in the song), the scoring system has been altered slightly. The [url=https://tinyurl.com/y2b4hbda]scoring explanation[/url] has been updated accordingly. Please note that as a consequence, medals, ghosts, and leaderboards have been reset.

[h2]Upgraded leaderboard architecture:[/h2]

This new architecture will give us more freedom for our next features. For now, the biggest change is that your rank is recorded even over 2000, which was not possible before.
[i]Known issue:[/i] Your rank is not displayed in the leaderboards in the menu, this will be fixed in a future update very soon. Rest assured your high scores are recorded, you can find your ranks in the leaderboards at the end of a song or on the [url=https://www.ragnarock-vr.com/leaderboard]Ragnaröck website[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/0a15c98825582a2ef96314338eeca9d175a3a214.jpg[/img]

That's it for today! As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord channel[/url]!

notes.content:
[h2]Update #5: Vote for next song (BETA), bugfixes[/h2]
Ahoy captains!

We just released an update! Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback, and as always we want to give a very warm thank you to our reactive community and testers for their time and help! Here's what you will find in this update:

[list]
[*][PvP] [b]New vote feature (BETA)[/b] in multiplayer allowing everyone to vote for the next song at the end of a race. The game will select the most voted song, or randomly choose between the songs with equal votes. If there are no votes, song selection is random. The host can always change the song again at the beginning of the race.
[*] Menu button changed on Valve Index to avoid misclicks during game : now you must press the joystick
[*][Fix] When host disconnects, clients could not host or join another game
[*][Fix][PvP] When a player arrived in an already started session, menu was missing
[*][Fix][PvP] When host changes song, personal bests are now updated right away
[*][Fix] External cameras log spamming
[*][Fix] Vive Controllers Gen2 haptics & default orientation fixed (you will need to reset hammer orientation if you had changed it)
[*][Fix] In certain cases, quick menu didn't appear when clicking the menu button
[*] Added some UI animations on score panel
[*][PvP] Added a workaround when click is not possible on "Ready" button (we are sill working on a fix): use menu button to reload the menu

notes.content:
[h2]Update #4: New lobby environment, Host can choose song, New UI, Haptics settings, Optimizations, Hammer settings[/h2]

[*] New lobby environment : Viking Hall (Will you find all the hidden surprises in-game?)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/62076e84d0de03e04acb65e8b10fa59a157e8ed1.png[/img]

[*] [PvP] In hosted games, the host can now change the next song
[*] In solo, you can change the selected song again before starting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4c67074990bff26a9532917ee1a48bed14adc942.png[/img]

[*] Advanced settings to adjust hammer rotation/position (6 degrees of freedom, useful for those who play with special grips)

[*] [Fix] Better audio/mapping synchronization on “Nitro - The SIDH” levels 1, 5, 9

notes.title: New update available for Ragnaröck #2
notes.content:
[h2]Update #2: Recenter feature, Audio and latency settings, Display drums/hammers adjustments[/h2]

How's it going, mighty vikings?

We're still following closely your reviews and feedbacks on Steam and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord[/url]. Thanks for helping us improve Ragnaröck! A new update is now available with the following changes:

- Option to [b]recenter your position[/b] in-game: located after the drums and hammers adjustements (this will snap your drums in front of you wherever your are placed)
- [b]Display drum height and hammer angle values[/b] so you can take note and set them back quickly if you move them. We are considering adding different profiles of players later to have multiple settings.
- Fix rank display for in-game leaderboard
- Added [b]"Audio" settings[/b] to control sound volume for Master/UI/Track/Voice/Combo/Drums
- Added [b]"Latency" setting[/b] to customize music/rune synchronization, located in the "Audio" settings.
- Stabilization of music/rune synchronization

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/b30098c625f8f53edd286ededfcd5f69f8faf0e1.png[/img]

[i]Note: If you feel like the synchronization between music and rune is off (if you're using bluetooth headphones for example), use the Latency setting. Our recommendation: check your average latency on your left score panel at the end of each song and enter the opposite value as your latency setting (eg. if your latency average is -10ms, set your latency to 10).[/i]

Keep playing and tell us what you think! You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord channel[/url]!

notes.title: Multiplayer mode is coming soon !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/d2257fe787f2a99d510dd88b109e4206f9c23d09.jpg[/img]

We are working very hard on the multiplayer mode for Ragnaröck right now, and we wanted to present this awesome feature to you.

Indeed, on top of the solo mode, you will also be able to play together from 2 to 8 players. In this online multiplayer PvP mode, everyone will lead their own viking ship, and compete in a side-by-side boat race.

All ships start aligned on the dock and set sail together when the song starts. The gameplay stays the same, meaning crushing the runes in sync with the music to go forward, and using the combo at the right time for speed boosts! And of course, the goal is to take your boat further than all the others thanks to your amazing skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/218061602ff23aae0a1b51e850a52a2471fe357f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Crush the runes, defeat your opponents![/h3]

During the race, the competition will be raging as you try to overtake your friends and finish on top of the scoreboard. Keep an eye on everyone else, but also don’t lose your concentration and keep hitting runes precisely, or others might pass you by.

You will be able to play with your friends on private servers or join a public server for a quick game. All compatible headsets can play together in Ragnaröck.

We can’t wait to release this cool multiplayer mode and see you guys have fun together (hopefully no friendship will be broken in the process XD )!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e8450da0b7209e47ba700d6d46d4809f1ac66520.jpg[/img]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

We work hard everyday to improve Ragnaröck, and we will post regular updates about development goals and achievements. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord channel[/url]!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/WanadevStudio-340492510171086/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/WanadevStudio]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/wanadevstudio/]Instagram[/url]!

See you soon for more news on Ragnaröck. The Early Access release is right around the corner!
